assist.exactQuestion: Acquire materially new primary or independent evidence reusable by the root owner to close source-addressed underwriting gaps.

facts: Q2 FY2027 revenue was $771.773M, up 30% year over year.
Atlas-related revenue was $565.916M versus $438.970M a year earlier, approximately 29% growth.
GAAP operating income was $28.4M versus a $65.3M operating loss a year earlier.
Free cash flow was $137.6M and non-GAAP operating margin was 24% versus 15% a year earlier.
Full-year FY2027 revenue guidance was raised to $2.99B-$3.03B; management stated the H2 raise was mainly due to Atlas.
